name: blueprint/style-pass
description: Tone shifts that verify: classify the current tone, the agent rewrites, classify again, store the before/after pair as evidence
recipe: classify the current tone against the closed set -> rewrite (the agent's work) -> classify again - the label must move -> store both versions as the evidence
pitfalls: classify answers verbatim or errors - the tone set is closed
the rewrite is the agent's; a tool that rewrites would be a drafting tool, and there is none by design
a label that did not move means the pass failed - do not ship the rewrite
